newsitem.title: USA: JTS ships new family of PC hard drives.
newsitem.headline: JTS ships new family of PC hard drives.

text.p: Disk drive maker JTS Corp said it was shipping its Champion family of 3.5-inch hard disk drives with capacity ranging up to three gigabytes.
The company said its Champion family of Fast ATA-3 disk drives have capacities of 1.7, 2.0, 2.5 and 3.0 gigabytes, or billions of bytes.
The products are aimed at the Intel Corp Pentium-based desktop PC market, and are capable of handling full-screen, full-motion video for multimedia applications.
JTS is based in San Jose, Calif. It made the announcement at the CeBIT computer trade show in Hanover, Germany.
